remarks:
Welcome home to a house cared for inside and out, with the big updates already done.

It starts with the charming front porch, the perfect spot for your morning coffee or waving to neighbors on a summer evening. Behind it, the exterior was built to last with almost no upkeep. A metal roof was installed in 2025; the metal siding matches it, and the garage was re-sided in metal last year. Even the driveway is brand new: a rubber surface installed by Apollo of Hamburg, backed by a warranty. A nice two-car garage out back has new siding.

Step inside and you'll find gleaming hardwood floors through much of the home, a cozy gas fireplace that makes Western New York winters something to look forward to, and central air that makes the hot, humid parts of summer much more comfortable. Flip a switch for instant warmth and ambiance, with no wood to haul. The kitchen pairs easy-care vinyl flooring with stainless steel appliances, all included. Most of the windows have been replaced within the last five years, filling the rooms with natural light.

Then the kitchen leads out to the real showstopper: a brand-new covered back deck, built in 2025. Picture summer cookouts, quiet evenings, and rainy-day afternoons outdoors without a worry about the weather.

The basement includes a washer and dryer, so all you have to do is unpack. With a new roof, deck, driveway, and garage siding, plus newer windows, this home has been well cared for. Homes this well-kept don't come along often, so schedule your showing before it's gone.
